challenges.title: Complex PDF Layout & Schema Tables
challenges.description: Bidding documents contain complex wiring scheds, camera layout sheets, and PAGA coverage maps in tables. Standard text parsers split cells and lose column alignments.
challenges.mitigation: Reviewer uses visual page coordinate grids and cell boundary maps during PyMuPDF scanning to preserve row association.

challenges.title: Cross-System Requirement Scattering
challenges.description: Cabling requirements are often detailed in civil/electrical files, cyber certifications in PLC/DCS guidelines, and alarm beacons under fire-safety codes, scattering telecom specs.
challenges.mitigation: Run multi-document semantic scanning referencing cable ducts, UPS feeds, and instrument panels back to a master telecom interface chart.

challenges.title: Vague Wording & Compliance Ambiguities
challenges.description: Frequent phrases like 'as approved by engineer' or 'contractor shall provide as required' introduce significant scope and pricing uncertainty.
challenges.mitigation: Flag non-committal auxiliary verbs to raise pre-bid Technical Queries (TQs) requesting exact brands, models, and counts.

challenges.title: IT/OT Segregation & Cybersecurity Gaps
challenges.description: Cybersecurity compliance is mandated, but boundary responsibility between DCS switches, corporate firewalls, and telecom networks is frequently omitted.
challenges.mitigation: Draft explicit network interface boundary matrixes to define clear vendor scopes at DMZ junction interfaces.

tqs.description: Specification contains conflicting requirements for CCTV video recording history. Part-A Page 43 mandates 2 months (60 days) minimum storage, whereas Part B references may call for 30 or 90 days. Please clarify the correct video recording history duration.
tqs.proposal: Bidder proposes to design and size the NVR storage capacity for 90 days of continuous recording at 25 fps, 1080p resolution, to ensure compliance with the highest specified standard.

tqs.description: UPS battery backup duration is conflicting: Part-A page 37 specifies 3 hours backup for Carbon Capture plant (Simhadri), whereas page 42 specifies 2 hours backup for Pudimadaka C&I systems. Please clarify the required duration at both sites.
tqs.proposal: Bidder proposes 3 hours backup for Simhadri UPS and 2 hours backup for Pudimadaka UPS as specified in the respective sections.

tqs.description: Part-A page 40 specifies that all electronic modules PCBs should have conformal coating for coastal protection. Please clarify if this is mandatory for all package/OEM PLCs (e.g., compressor PLC, water treatment PLC) or only the main plant DCS.
tqs.proposal: Bidder proposes that all electronic modules and PCBs in the main DCS and critical package PLCs located in the plant areas will be supplied with conformal coating.

tqs.description: Cybersecurity compliance is mandated, but boundary demarcation firewalls and network interface scopes between Telecom switches and the DCS control systems are not defined.
tqs.proposal: Bidder proposes to configure a demilitarized zone (DMZ) with a managed Level-3 firewall at the interface junction boundary.

workflows.name: Document Pre-processing & Scope Identification
workflows.desc: Index all PDF volumes using PyMuPDF to extract text and tables. Filter documents containing keywords like 'telecom', 'paga', 'cctv', 'network', 'cables', 'security'.

workflows.name: Subsystem Requirement Extraction
workflows.desc: Extract and structure requirements for each subsystem: CCTV storage days, camera count, PAGA dB levels, telephone line counts, fiber optic core specifications, and UPS backup times.

workflows.name: Compliance & Conflict Auditing
workflows.desc: Audit extracted specs against standard rules: check for internal contradictions (e.g., one page asking for 30 days CCTV storage, another asking for 90 days), and cross-reference standards (e.g. IEC 62443, ATEX).

workflows.name: Technical Clarification (TQ) Generation
workflows.desc: Automatically compile a list of Technical Queries (TQs) for all vague, conflicting, or missing requirements to submit to the project owner.

workflows.name: Wiki Dashboard Update
workflows.desc: Export structured wiki data to the master database, updating system architectures, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
